package.name: vision_bridge
package.description: Open-vocabulary vision detection bridge node: subscribes to an image stream plus a text query (parameter and/or topic), publishes DetectionResult/DetectionArray. Detection backend is pluggable (auto/tensorrt/pytorch/stub, see detector_factory.py): OWL-ViT vision tower via a TensorRT engine built on-device, falling back to eager PyTorch when no usable engine is present. Runtime deps beyond this package's own rosdep keys -- torch, transformers, and (Jetson-only) tensorrt/pycuda -- are not pip-managed here; see ros2_ws/README.md.
